messages:
Elena: FYI VendorSol just flagged a capacity reroute: our 3-rack EU reserve is being moved from Hamburg to Rotterdam due to berth congestion. ETA shift from 2025-10-02 -> 2025-10-10. This impacts the marketplace staging window and the partner SI onboarding.
Mark: Does the reroute change manifests or HS codes? Any customs impacts?
Vendor-Sol: (Vendor) Confirmed: ports changed only. No HS/commodity changes. We do need updated delivery terms on the PO and will issue a revised manifest with new vessel/ETA by EOD.
Priy: Can we request one rack routed to our EU partner DC earlier via intermodal transfer? We need at least one rack for SI testing next week.
Vendor-Sol: Intermodal early pickup possible for 1 rack, carrier fee + handling ~\u20ac2,500. Will need new ship instruction and to flag serials for early release.
Elena: Product prefers single-rack early pickup for SI sandbox, but Finance ok? @Mark can you confirm budget or partnership co-op?
Mark: Quick calc: \u20ac2.5k + customs broker ~\u20ac400. If co-op covers, ok. Tagging Finance in parallel.
Priy: Operational note: early pickup means we must lock license tokens and pre-seed inventory in marketplace to avoid provisioning gaps. @OpsBot can you gate listing until full QA?
OpsBot: Auto: Will create a partner-only "preview" gating flag. No provisioning or billing until explicit go-live.
Legal: Need vendor to include certificate of origin and invoice for customs pre-clear. Also confirm whether early pickup changes Incoterms (likely EXW vs DAP).
Vendor-Sol: Will attach CO and invoice in revised manifest. Incoterm remains DAP; early pickup will be done under the same PO with amended delivery window.
Elena: Please post the revised manifest and serials here ASAP. Action list: 1) Vendor to send revised manifest + CO (EOD). 2) Mark to confirm co-op authorisation. 3) Priy to coordinate SI engineer booking for early rack. 4) Ops to enable partner-preview gating.
Vendor-Sol: Manifest snippet (to follow with full file):
```
PO: 100889
SKU: RACK-FLEX-16GPU
Qty total: 3
Early release serial: RS-2201
Port ETA (rotterdam): 2025-10-10
```
Mark: Noted. If Finance declines co-op, we'll revert to consolidated arrival and delay pilot.
Elena: Thanks everyone. Keep updates in-thread; I'll consolidate decisions after manifest lands. :white_check_mark:
